title: Luxforge timing and resources by cohort
description: Percentiles computed from individual event rows, grouped by app, OS, CPU, GPU and memory cohorts.

options.content:
**How to read this dashboard.** Reporting is **opt-in**, so every number describes only the installations whose owners chose to share, not everyone who uses Luxforge, and those people may differ from the rest. Delivery is **best-effort**: batches and events can be lost (the loss panels count the gaps that are visible), and the **end of a session is never seen**: nothing after the last received batch exists here. A **session** is one app launch; an **installation** is one random ID kept by one install. Neither is a person or a physical device: one person can have several installations, an installation can be reset, and the ID is not an account. Image IDs are meaningful only inside one installation. Sparse cohorts can identify an installation and do not prove anonymity. Rows expire 90 days after receipt.

Percentiles are **exact and computed from the individual event rows** in each cohort (interpolated between closest ranks). They are never averages or combinations of per-batch percentiles. Read `samples`, `sessions` and `installations` first: a cohort with a handful of sessions says little about anyone else.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.${cohort:raw} AS cohort, uniqExact(e.session_id) AS sessions, uniqExact(e.installation_id) AS installations, count() AS events
FROM luxforge.events_unique AS e INNER JOIN luxforge.session_profiles AS p ON p.session_id = e.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.received_at) GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY sessions DESC

SELECT p.${cohort:raw} AS cohort, count() AS samples, uniqExact(e.session_id) AS sessions, uniqExact(e.installation_id) AS installations,
       round(quantileExactInclusive(0.5)(e.duration_ms)) AS p50, round(quantileExactInclusive(0.9)(e.duration_ms)) AS p90,
       round(quantileExactInclusive(0.95)(e.duration_ms)) AS p95, round(quantileExactInclusive(0.99)(e.duration_ms)) AS p99, max(e.duration_ms) AS max
FROM luxforge.events_unique AS e INNER JOIN luxforge.session_profiles AS p ON p.session_id = e.session_id WHERE e.name = 'preview.settled' AND $__timeFilter(e.received_at) GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY samples DESC

panels.title: Completed operation duration (ms) by cohort, for the selected operation

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.${cohort:raw} AS cohort, count() AS samples, uniqExact(e.session_id) AS sessions, uniqExact(e.installation_id) AS installations,
       round(quantileExactInclusive(0.5)(e.duration_ms)) AS p50, round(quantileExactInclusive(0.9)(e.duration_ms)) AS p90,
       round(quantileExactInclusive(0.95)(e.duration_ms)) AS p95, max(e.duration_ms) AS max
FROM luxforge.events_unique AS e INNER JOIN luxforge.session_profiles AS p ON p.session_id = e.session_id WHERE e.name = 'operation.end' AND e.operation = '${operation}' AND e.outcome = 'completed' AND $__timeFilter(e.received_at)
GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY samples DESC

panels.title: CPU, memory and GPU samples by cohort
panels.description: Memory kinds differ by operating system (`footprint`, `resident`, `private`) and are not comparable with each other.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.${cohort:raw} AS cohort, e.memory_kind AS memory_kind, count() AS samples, uniqExact(e.session_id) AS sessions,
       round(quantileExactInclusive(0.5)(e.cpu_percent)) AS "cpu% p50", round(quantileExactInclusive(0.95)(e.cpu_percent)) AS "cpu% p95",
       round(quantileExactInclusive(0.5)(e.memory_mib)) AS "mem MiB p50", round(quantileExactInclusive(0.95)(e.memory_mib)) AS "mem MiB p95", max(e.memory_mib) AS "mem MiB max",
       round(quantileExactInclusive(0.5)(e.gpu_percent)) AS "gpu% p50", round(quantileExactInclusive(0.95)(e.gpu_percent)) AS "gpu% p95",
       round(quantileExactInclusive(0.95)(e.gpu_memory_mib)) AS "gpu mem MiB p95"
FROM luxforge.events_unique AS e INNER JOIN luxforge.session_profiles AS p ON p.session_id = e.session_id WHERE e.name = 'process.sample' AND $__timeFilter(e.received_at) GROUP BY cohort, memory_kind ORDER BY samples DESC

panels.title: Preview settle time per day (all cohorts)
panels.description: Each point is the percentile of that day's individual events.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(received_at) AS time,
       quantileExactInclusive(0.5)(duration_ms) AS p50, quantileExactInclusive(0.95)(duration_ms) AS p95
FROM luxforge.events_unique WHERE name = 'preview.settled' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Preview settle p95 per day by cohort

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(e.received_at) AS time, p.${cohort:raw} AS cohort, quantileExactInclusive(0.95)(e.duration_ms) AS p95
FROM luxforge.events_unique AS e INNER JOIN luxforge.session_profiles AS p ON p.session_id = e.session_id WHERE e.name = 'preview.settled' AND $__timeFilter(e.received_at) GROUP BY time, cohort ORDER BY time
